mapper.select: SELECT s.PARKING_SPACE_ID AS "parkingSpaceId", s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE AS "spaceStatusCode" FROM PARKING_SPACE s JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID WHERE (TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER) = #{spaceCode} FOR UPDATE OF s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_AI_DETECTION_EVENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AI_DETECTION_EVENT (AI_DETECTION_EVENT_ID, PARKING_SPACE_ID, DETECTED_AT, CREATED_AT, RAW_PAYLOAD) VALUES (#{aiDetectionEventId}, #{parkingSpaceId}, #{detectedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSDATE, #{rawPayload,jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.update: UPDATE PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY SET VALID_TO = SYSDATE WHERE PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{parkingSpaceId} AND VALID_TO IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY (PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY_ID, PARKING_SPACE_ID, PARKING_ZONE_ID, SPACE_NUMBER, SPACE_TYPE_CODE, SPACE_STATUS_CODE, X_POSITION, Y_POSITION, MEMO, CHANGED_BY_ADMIN_ID, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, CHANGE_SOURCE_CODE, CHANGE_REASON, AI_DETECTION_EVENT_ID) SELECT SEQ_PARKING_SPACE_HISTORY.NEXTVAL, s.PARKING_SPACE_ID, s.PARKING_ZONE_ID, s.SPACE_NUMBER, s.SPACE_TYPE_CODE, s.SPACE_STATUS_CODE, s.X_POSITION, s.Y_POSITION, s.MEMO, NULL, SYSDATE, NULL, 'AI', 'AI occupancy state confirmed', #{aiDetectionEventId} FROM PARKING_SPACE s WHERE s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = #{parkingSpaceId}
